env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A segment operand of a group stage that is not a lambda literal is
# evaluated once, before the stage starts, on the calling goroutine, in
# source order with the source, the context, and the limit, natively and
# in the ejected module. chain_stage_operands.lgo prints one ok line per
# form.
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_operands.lgo a/main.lgo

cd a
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_operands.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! exists out/main.lgo
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_operands.out
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds and runs with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_operands.out
cd ../..

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/chainstageoperands

go 1.27
